author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
The Authority's current mandatory Mirror contract depends on an original tool for which its inspected distribution supplies no source. This blocks the required EAP assessment/outbox path. It is an Authority dependency/delivery defect, not evidence that Claude caused the missing dependency.

## Independently checked subject

- Authority Main `d5e3181db664258bba8815d6d2a962dfcda80e31`, TREE `c6fafcb1a94bef904b4935d0a0797fb0045b1378`. Original recursive Git tree read:6479 entries,`truncated=false`,neither `node-tools` nor the required tool exists.
- `policy/HUMAN_MACHINE_PROGRESS_PROTOCOL.json#/client_continuation/native_session_use/mirror_outbox` selects `node-tools/qikvrt_mirror_emit.py`, assessments `assess`/`adopt`, original engine/protocol/native-writer checks, NOT_SENT outbox, signed package and exact named-node claim. It sets both outside assessment and replacement implementation/invented CLI to FORBIDDEN; unavailable source must be recovered or held. Existing allowed transfer carriers do not substitute for this prerequisite.
- Commit `de01755741cda99bd8ca59bcbb83d784d022a6d9`, dated2026-10-19T12:34:14Z, adds communication-claim validation/references and says "Keep the original outbox tool". It attributes diagnosis/implementation to Codex. Its eight changed files contain no tool implementation. The current structured exclusive mirror_outbox block carries a later same-day Owner instruction; these contract layers are distinguished rather than attributed wholesale to a single patch.
- Version48 of the existing original continuation archive (`QIKVRT_Autostart_20261020_v48.zip`) was retrieved and SHA256-verified:77585441 bytes,`bb11f25da1db86582730522897554cd2ebfff86ece41b6ac216e4704c5a845c1`. Its2498 outer members and23 embedded ZIPs contain no tool implementation. It includes the archived record `pr548-native-result-20261019/native-events/original-outbox-tool-source-missing.event.json`,timestamp2026-10-19T12:24:04.528182Z,subject fbc450c4/15eb1a7b,explicitly documenting the missing original source. This is an original archived record, not a newly executed native event or a proof of globally nonexistent source.
- Bounded local source recovery found no loose file in `/workspace` and the available skills source tree.2812 local ZIPs were inspected by member name;one retained stale-transfer ZIP was unreadable,so no universal negative claim. The named historic bundle digestd0b1c993 was absent among74 local bundle files/two distinct digests. The available Library matches contain missing-source statements or handoff metadata, not a recovered implementation.

## Owner-supplied historical finding and limits

Ingolf Lohmann reports checking all branches,644 PR heads and all history and finding that the tool never occurred there. Preserve this as OWNER_ASSERTED historical audit; this work did not repeat that exhaustive historical scan. The own checks establish the current distribution defect and corroborating archived missing-source records. No access to every external/Owner-controlled machine is claimed.

Missing boot discipline may delay diagnosis; it does not create the missing file. No session-specific authentication failure should replace this diagnosed source dependency. Conversely recovering a file alone cannot establish writer admission, authenticated peer ingress, delivery or productive acceptance. Native endpoint admission/host/credential gates remain separately open.

## Bounded repair and closure criteria

1. Recover actual original bytes and their verifiable source/provenance through existing admitted QIK-VRT sources; preserve the original journals and grants. Bind source path/version/hash, rights, dependencies, supported CLI, signer and writer admission.
2. Integrate the proven original distribution or pinned admitted installation carrier into the Authority. Add a cold-source/package regression that detects this exact missing mandatory dependency instead of allowing a conforming node to discover it only at return time.
3. Inspect the original contract before running `status`; verify existing assessment/package/claim operations and negative missing-source/unauthorized-writer cases without copied-journal writes. Obtain real request/ACK/reply through the existing admitted carrier with independent named-node effect readback.
4. If no original can be recovered, the existing exclusive contract remains unsatisfied. A new compatible implementation or alternate assessment route requires an explicit versioned Owner contract decision; generic continuation permission must not silently override the explicit replacement ban. This issue authorizes no substitute CLI, synthetic success/ACK, scope expansion, Owner packet relay or new executor/timer.

Keep this dependency OPEN until source/distribution/acceptance evidence meets its named scope. Do not reopen unrelated completed quota or Cookie repairs and do not infer EFFECT_ACK_DONE. Codex records the finding and its own verification limits; repository metadata alone proves no natural-person inspection or peer adoption.
title: Authority requires missing original Mirror outbox tool: source/distribution dependency HOLD
